PROPERTIES.player_hint_1_en: Only one square fits both parts of Arlo's clue ("He was sitting in a chair in the Pool."). So Arlo (A) must be at row 1, column 2. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_2_en: With the rows and columns of Arlo crossed out, only one square is left for Freya that fits her clue ("She was in the Pool, but not beside the water."). So Freya (F) must be at row 3, column 1. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_3_en: Look at Daisy: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 7, column 4. So nobody else can stand at row 7, column 4, or Daisy would have nowhere to go. Daisy's clue ("She was in the same area as someone on a carpet.") needs the person on a carpet in Daisy's area on a square that does not share her row or column; that rules out squares for Daisy. So Daisy (D) must be at row 6, column 4. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_4_en: Look at Esme: every square she could still use shares a row or column with row 2, column 3. So nobody else can stand at row 2, column 3, or Esme would have nowhere to go. Who can be the person on a carpet in Daisy's area? Only Cyril, because nobody else can still reach a square that fits Daisy's clue ("She was in the same area as someone on a carpet."). That rules out Cyril's other squares. So Cyril (C) must be at row 7, column 3. Cross out his row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_5_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Esme that fits her clue ("She was in the Bar."). So Esme (E) must be at row 2, column 5. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_6_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Vanessa. So Vanessa (the victim) must be at row 4, column 6. Cross out her row and column.
PROPERTIES.player_hint_7_en: With the rows and columns of everyone placed so far crossed out, only one square is left for Bert that fits his clue ("He was exactly one column east of Vanessa."). So Bert (B) must be at row 5, column 7. Cross out his row and column. Bert is the only person in the Suite with Vanessa, so Bert is the murderer!
